buttons.label: 相簿
buttons.goes: scene 0x441048 Album (album\*.spr from album.dat on Disc 2): 3 buttons → card viewer arg0 = 機會卡 (album\chance\), arg1 = 四字真言 (album\card\), 2 = back; viewer has prev/next/back

buttons.label: 載入進度
buttons.goes: load dialog FUN_0040a6b0 → scene 0x4411b0 (game) with slot

layout: buttons in one row: x = (W-640)/2 + 0x50 + i*0x5f (80,175,270,365,460,555 in 640), y = H-50 (y1=y2); menu.spr frame0 (glow) eases to hovered button x (div 4), frames 2..7 labels; frame1 drawn at selection
idle: no mouse movement for 30 s → attract: scene 0x4411f0 (opening video loop)

buttons.exit: fg frames 2,3,4 → back to main menu

selectMiniGame.frames: normal/hover/pressed = n,n+1,n+2; fg frame0+1 drawn at centre
selectMiniGame.sounds: dan01.wav on hover change, button.wav on click
selectMiniGame.returnDelay: 80 ticks after click before launching; on return re-inits + random transition (FUN_0041e3d0)
